'''FC Istogu''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Istogu}}), commonly known as '''Istogu''' is a [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Istok, Kosovo|Istog]], [[Kosovo]]. The club plays in the [[First Football League of Kosovo]], which is the second tier of football in the country."}}
